verdict.rationale: Hands-on testers describe the OCR API as "super fast and synchronous" and "super fast" (comm-3, comm-1). The docs list a separate /v1/batch mode (docs-37), so there is a sync vs. batch split, and the API worked when large documents were split into chunks (comm-2). However, no first-party documentation states latency for either mode, and the speed claims are anecdotal. Missing for 10: documented latency figures per mode (sync vs batch), first-party description of the synchronous mode's response-time guarantees, and documented page/size limits for interactive use.
